title: Illustration / Shadows and shading
slide_intent: Keep depth cues consistent because a shadow can contradict an otherwise flat drawing.
strategic_value: Pill shadows and restrained shading can preserve Duolingo’s flat style while simplifying animation.
demonstration: Three paired rows compare pill versus oval shadows, darker versus lighter ground shadows, and consistent versus altered rear-part colors.
practical_value: Check shadow shape, relative darkness and unnecessary depth shading separately.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says ovals imply perspective and extra shading adds colors and limits animation flexibility.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Shadows appear below as pills, never ovals, and must be darker than their base; avoid recoloring parts merely to place them farther back.

ingredient.name: Illustration shadows
ingredient.role: Ground flat objects without introducing conflicting perspective.
ingredient.application: Use a darker pill shadow below; avoid oval shadows and unnecessary rear-part color shifts.
ingredient.scope: Historical illustration guidance; darkness is relative to the base, with no numerical contrast ratio stated.
